name: AGASA Collaboration
notes: The member page marks M. Teshima as spokesperson; no leadership row is written because no person record exists for him.

summary.plain: The Japanese-led team of cosmic-ray physicists that built and ran the AGASA air-shower array at Akeno.
summary.technical: Collaboration of 29 listed members from the University of Tokyo ICRR, Yamanashi, Saitama, Tokyo Institute of Technology, Osaka City, Chiba, Ehime and other universities and institutes, with the Max-Planck-Institut für Physik; spokesperson M. Teshima (member page, 2007).
